title: A Study to Investigate the Effect of Injection Site and Ethnicity on KAI-4729 Pharmacokinetics in Non-Asian and Asian Participants Living With Obesity or Overweight
official: A Phase 1, Randomized, Open-Label, Single-Dose Study to Investigate the Effect of Injection Site on Relative Bioavailability of KAI-4729 Subcutaneous Injection and Pharmacokinetics of KAI-4729 in Non-Asian and Asian Participants Living With Obesity or Overweight
summary: The main objectives of this study are to assess the relative bioavailability of KAI-4729 subcutaneous (SC) injection in the upper arm and thigh compared with the abdomen and to measure the pharmacokinetics of KAI-4729 in plasma following a single SC dose in healthy non-Asian and Asian participants.
criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Have a body mass index (BMI) ≥25 and ≤40 kilograms per square meter at screening (Days -28 to -2) and on Day -1 of the first Treatment Period
* Non-Asian Participants Only: Be of non-Asian descent and not identify as being of East Asian origin
* Asian Participants Only: Be of Asian descent, identify as being of East Asian origin, and have both parents and both sets of grandparents born in East Asia and of East Asian descent
* Medically healthy

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Have estimated glomerular filtration rate \<60 milliliters/minute/1.73 square meters at screening (Days -28 to -2) using the 2021 Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration calculation.
* Have hemoglobin A1c test result ≥6.5% or blood glucose ≥126 milligrams/deciliter (≥7 millimoles/liter) at screening (Days -28 to -2).
* Have a history of, or positive test results at screening (Days -28 to -2) for, human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B surface antigen, or active hepatitis C virus infection.
* Have positive drugs of abuse or alcohol test results at screening (Days -28 to -2) or on Day -1 of each Treatment Period.
* Be pregnant or planning to be pregnant and/or breastfeeding or planning to breastfeed during the study and within 5 half-lives of the study drug (25 days) following the last study treatment dose.
* Have any history of malignant disease, including in situ cervical or prostate cancer, within the 5 years prior to informed consent (excludes basal or squamous cell carcinoma that was successfully treated).
* Have history or presence of clinically significant cardiovascular, pulmonary, hepatic, renal, hematological, gastrointestinal, endocrine, immunologic, dermatologic, psychiatric, or neurological disease/disorder, including any acute illness, within the 3 months prior to informed consent determined by the Investigator (or delegate) to be clinically relevant.
* Have known hypersensitivity to the study drug; glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1), glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide, and/or glucagon receptor agonist therapies; or any of the study drug ingredients.
* Have any other conditions or received prior therapy that, in the opinion of the Investigator (or delegate), would make the participant unsuitable for this study, including inability to cooperate fully with the requirements of the study protocol or likelihood of noncompliance with any study requirements.

Note: Additional inclusion/exclusion criteria may apply, per protocol.
